+import sys
+import unittest
+
+from lark import Tree
+
+
+class TestSubtreePostorder(unittest.TestCase):
+    def assert_postorder(self, root, reachable):
+        nodes = list(root.iter_subtrees())
+        ids = [id(node) for node in nodes]
+        self.assertEqual(len(ids), len(reachable))
+        self.assertEqual(set(ids), {id(node) for node in reachable})
+        positions = {node_id: i for i, node_id in enumerate(ids)}
+        for parent in reachable:
+            for child in parent.children:
+                if isinstance(child, Tree):
+                    self.assertLess(positions[id(child)], positions[id(parent)])
+        return nodes
+
+    def test_shared_leaf_at_different_depths(self):
+        leaf = Tree('leaf', [])
+        branch = Tree('branch', [leaf])
+        root = Tree('root', [branch, leaf])
+        nodes = self.assert_postorder(root, [root, branch, leaf])
+        self.assertEqual([id(n) for n in nodes], [id(leaf), id(branch), id(root)])
+
+    def test_shared_descendant_with_both_child_orders(self):
+        for reverse in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(reverse=reverse):
+                leaf = Tree('leaf', [])
+                middle = Tree('middle', [leaf])
+                branch = Tree('branch', [middle])
+                children = [branch, leaf, middle, branch]
+                if reverse:
+                    children.reverse()
+                root = Tree('root', children + ['token', None, {'payload': 1}])
+                self.assert_postorder(root, [root, branch, middle, leaf])
+
+    def test_structurally_equal_distinct_nodes(self):
+        left = Tree('equal', [Tree('leaf', [])])
+        right = Tree('equal', [Tree('leaf', [])])
+        self.assertEqual(left, right)
+        self.assertIsNot(left, right)
+        root = Tree('root', [left, right, left])
+        self.assert_postorder(root, [root, left, right, left.children[0], right.children[0]])
+
+    def test_deeper_than_recursion_limit(self):
+        leaf = Tree('leaf', [])
+        reachable = [leaf]
+        root = leaf
+        for i in range(sys.getrecursionlimit() + 100):
+            root = Tree('branch', [root])
+            reachable.append(root)
+        nodes = self.assert_postorder(root, reachable)
+        self.assertEqual([id(n) for n in nodes], [id(n) for n in reachable])
+
+    def test_topdown_and_metadata_unchanged(self):
+        leaf = Tree('leaf', [])
+        branch = Tree('branch', [leaf])
+        root = Tree('root', [branch, leaf])
+        reachable = [root, branch, leaf]
+        metas = [node.meta for node in reachable]
+        for i, meta in enumerate(metas):
+            meta.tag = i
+        self.assert_postorder(root, reachable)
+        self.assertEqual([id(n) for n in root.iter_subtrees_topdown()], [id(root), id(branch), id(leaf), id(leaf)])
+        for i, node in enumerate(reachable):
+            self.assertIs(node.meta, metas[i])
+            self.assertEqual(node.meta.tag, i)

spec.question: A metadata aggregation pass using `Tree.iter_subtrees()` encounters a branch before its shared leaf for this graph: `leaf = Tree('leaf', [])`, `branch = Tree('branch', [leaf])`, and `root = Tree('root', [branch, leaf])`. Repair the traversal so that, for any finite acyclic graph of Tree objects, every reachable Tree object—including the root—is yielded exactly once by identity, and every Tree child precedes each of its parents. Structurally equal but distinct objects must both be visited, repeated references must not duplicate visits, and traversal must work for trees deeper than Python's recursion limit without changing that limit. Ignore non-Tree children; no particular relative order is required between unrelated nodes. Leave the graph, metadata, `iter_subtrees_topdown()`, and position propagation unchanged. Return a unified diff against the repository files without changing tests.
